# alejandro-is.me

> Personal portfolio of Alejandro Amaro Mendoza — Product & Visual Designer based in Strasbourg, France.

## Site Structure

- **Homepage** (`/`): Single-page landing with hero, about, skills, experience, projects, education, and contact sections.
- **Portfolio** (`/portfolio.html`): Filterable grid of all case studies.
- **Projects** (`/projects/`): Individual case study pages:
  - In-House Tools — A social post generator and a rental contract generator in daily use at the shop where Alejandro works as in-house designer. Alejandro defines the problem, behavior and rules; Claude writes the code
  - Keep Breathing — Survival FPS made in 48 hours at Global Game Jam 2026; Alejandro was project lead, game designer, 3D artist and UI designer. Best Technical Achievement
  - BEDiZEN — Final project for the CCI Campus Alsace Web UX/UI Designer certification. Brand and UX/UI; v1 coded by hand, v2 built with AI on a 4-column grid Alejandro defined; database, hosting and WordPress set up by Alejandro
  - Spin App — Brand and UX redesign of a mobile top-up app that moves the reward wheel to after payment. Never implemented, for lack of funding
  - WorkPics — Logo and app screens for a developer friend's field reporting app for construction teams, published on Google Play
  - Cinéville Festival — Surrealist film festival poster, made as a graded exam exercise (not a real client)
  - Other Works — Illustration, logo design, and digital art gallery

Built with Jekyll (static site generator), vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. Hosted on GitHub Pages.
